description: A memory-editing synth. Sands the barbs off your worst recollections. Mostly.

overdose.message: It edits one memory too many — the one where your heart remembers to beat.

phases.end_message: The edits settle. A few of the barbs quietly grow back.
phases.peak_message: Old wounds you carry go soft and distant, like they happened to someone else.

effects.take_line: You dose {name} and let it go looking.

withdrawal.message: The memories come back sharp and all at once. Only memhack files them down.

name: Memhack
